components.text: Day unnumbered. Wind from the northwest, the island rolls. They called me Skyward: wind, cloud, building in the air. Mechanist counted cogs, Wildlander tracks. I counted altitude.$(br)$(br)✎ Altitude is approximate. A Supplementaries altimeter lies in a storm.
I went to shut a burner on a balloon over the storm archipelago. The log stayed in the basket. If a page is wet, that is rain, not blood.
